Affliction Warlock Rotation in 

Affliction Warlock is a fairly simple generator ➜ spender rotation at its core. With a few short cooldowns, there are just a small handful of rules to follow in general:

 Don't overcap your Soul Shards - Soul Shards are your resource and are limited to a max of 5. Overcapping on them is a DPS loss, and they should not be pooled unless heading into a damage window.
 

 React to procs- Both Shard Instability and Nightfall will proc often, which players need to be aware of to maximize damage and not overcap on the effects..

 Pre-Combat Check

 Before any combat happens, it is important for Affliction Warlock to make sure the following are done. This applies to raids, dungeons, delves, or even open-world content.

 AfflictionWarlock Major Cooldowns

Dark Harvest is a spec tree talent, but functions differently based on whether you choose Soul Harvester or Hellcaller. The ability also has cooldown reduction via Cull the Weak, making it roughly a 40-second cooldown. 

For Hellcaller, it is simply an effect that you will hit when it's off cooldown and you can gain damage value from it, with not much else to it. For Soul Harvester, however, it is the main capstone of the Hero Talent Tree in Shadow of Death. This effect grants you 3 Soul Shards every time you cast Dark Harvest, vastly increasing Affliction's Shard generation and overall Quality of Life. This also gives you a tad bit more CDR via Cull the Weak for Soul Harvester over Hellcaller, due to the increased Shards per minute it grants. 

Malevolence is your Hellcaller capstone ability and has a 1-minute cooldown. Due to the nature of Malevolence and the new Through the Felvine Hero Talent, you will want to pair this with every Darkglare cast. This means that you can cast Malevolence every minute, and have it pair back with Darkglare every two minutes. 

The effect itself is quite strong, granting the player a small Haste buff, while increasing the stack count of EACH active Wither by 6, and also causing targets affected by Wither to take damage. 

 Affliction Warlock Advanced Tips

 Gameplay and Pandemic 

 Affliction is not very complicated in Midnight, even with Unstable Affliction returning as your spender. You will want to cast essentially on CD, as long as you are not going to overcap on Soul Shards. Keep in mind that Dark Harvest only generates Soul Shards as Soul Harvester, not Hellcaller. 

Outside of that, you will want to maintain Unstable Affliction while also passively pooling shards for your Summon Darkglare window. You will also want to sync your Dark Harvest to your Darkglare window, to generate Shards (as Soul Harvester) once your pre-pooled shards have been spent. 

While it is not a massive DPS loss to refresh before your Pandemic window, it is still something to min/max. Refreshing DOTs on the move however is a DPS gain (over casting nothing) and is one of the main perks of Affliction, it's incredibly mobile.

DOT Pandemic Range
Agony - 4.5 Seconds
Corruption - 4.2 Seconds
Unstable Affliction - 6.3 Seconds

Comment by suchtie
Hey, good guide overall, the actual information seems to be correct, but there are some errors in terms of writing/formatting.

You're linking the Legion version of Unstable Affliction (ID 30108), when it was still a shard spender and stackable. In order to avoid confusion, you should use Unstable Affliction (ID 316099).
You're also linking the Shadowlands covenant ability version of Soul Rot (ID 325640). While it does the same thing, it has a different icon, which will be confusing for many readers. The current version is Soul Rot (ID 386997). This is even more important than the previous point because most players form an association between a spell and its icon. It's a visual aid that helps people retain the information and apply it to their gameplay, so using the correct icon is essential.
There is no Soul Harvester variant of the Opener section. Granted, the gameplay principles behind the opener are the same for SH, but the abilities you use are different. Corruption instead of Wither, Drain Soul instead of Shadow Bolt, and you don't have access to Malevolence. In my opinion it's also worth mentioning that Shadow Embrace stacks up to 4 rather than 2, but Haunt gives you a stack thanks to Improved Haunt (meaning you need 3 ticks of Drain Soul to fully stack it). Since Soul Harvester is very viable right now and even does better dps than Hellcaller—with the caveat of worse mobility—it definitely deserves inclusion.
Above the Opener section you tell the reader to select Phantom Singularity or Vile Taint, but there are no selector buttons for that.
The buttons in the AoE section are broken. While Hellcaller is selected, you can toggle both Phantom Singularity and Vile Taint simultaneously; this should be an exclusive toggle. Further, when Soul Harvester is selected, the PS/VT buttons don't do anything at all, and neither ability is mentioned in the text.
